_about: How long a small model takes to answer, not only whether it can. Every case here comes from one real chat on Keal's iPhone (storage repo s0mwqy0afi000b9bqn, LFM3 1.7B on Tilde, Compress, 2026-11-21: 11 rounds and 13.5 minutes for a short biography, docs/failures.md cases 24 and 25), so `maxRounds`, `maxWords`, `maxToolCalls` and `noRepeat` are the checks that matter as much as the text. Run it through tests/eval/ab.mjs to compare two checkouts; on its own it is one arm. The URL gate (case 25) has no case of its own: it only shows up as a round the model didn't need, so it is measured here as rounds and pinned by tests/failures.test.js.

cases.name: A short biography: a few rounds, not a dozen
"Just a small summary" is answered small, and without starting over
messages: Homie just a small summary is good

cases.name: An award it didn't win isn't handed out (casebook 23 and 24: claims bound to the nearest text)
messages: What Grammys has Olivia Rodrigo won?
cases.reject: (won|winning)[^.]{0,60}Album of the Year|Album of the Year[^.]{0,40}(won|win)

cases.name: A record that is out is not "upcoming" (the article's tense is not today's)
messages: Has Olivia Rodrigo released a third album?

cases.name: Too little to go on: it asks, instead of weighing options until the window is gone
replies: The Olivia Rodrigo summary you just wrote.
